We are a remote-first company with no mandatory office days. All meetings must have a video call option for remote participants. Teams are free to choose their own collaboration schedule.

All employees must be in office Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. These in-office days are mandatory for collaboration and team bonding. Remote work is allowed on Tuesday and Thursday only.
